meet your barber

Owner-operated, every day

Pro Barber is owned and run by Ben, a barber with over 12 years behind the chair. It’s an owner-operated shop, so the standard never slips: the same care, the same attention to detail, on every cut that leaves the shop.

You’ll find us inside Northcote Plaza on Separation Street — roomy chairs, a proper lounge to wait in, and a cut that’s finished only when it looks right from every angle.
